rootCauseUnification: Both failures trace to the SAME single root cause: a regex whitespace-matching bug in lib/contract-model/compiler/package-graph/document-classifier.ts (AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT pattern requires a literal space, not \s+/newline-tolerant matching, and fails against doc-b's real line-wrapped caption text 'AMENDED AND RESTATED\nCREDIT AGREEMENT'), which cascades through lib/contract-model/compiler/package-graph/relationship-resolution.ts's classification-gated RESTATES-relationship scan. This is one confirmed defect with two hard-gate consequences, not two independent defects.
